items.source: Create an instance wrapping the given Encoder.

items.source: Also a HttpMessageWriter that pre-resolves encoding hints from the extra information available on the server side such as the request or controller method annotations.
items.translation: 此外，还有一个 `<code>HttpMessageWriter`，它可以从服务器端可用的额外信息（例如请求或控制器方法注解）中预先解析编码提示。

items.source: Return the list of media types supported by this Writer. The list may not apply to every possible target element type and calls to this method should typically be guarded via canWrite(elementType, null). The list may also exclude media types supported only for a specific element type. Alternatively, use HttpMessageWriter.getWritableMediaTypes(ResolvableType) for a more precise list.
items.translation: 返回此 Writer 支持的媒体类型列表。该列表可能不适用于所有可能的目标元素类型，因此调用此方法时通常应通过 canWrite(elementType, null) 进行保护。该列表也可能排除仅针对特定元素类型支持的媒体类型。或者，使用 HttpMessageWriter.getWritableMediaTypes(ResolvableType) 获取更精确的列表。
